LESSON: SURAH NAAS

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.2: Surah Naas

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Surah Naas. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when praying?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. handle the Qurán with respect as a Holy book Surah Naas and listen to the recording 194
2. appreciate reciting Surah Naas as a prayer Surah Naas for matching using digital devices care of the Qurán

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. handle the Qurán with respect as a Holy book Surah Naas and listen to the recording 194
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to handle the Qurán with respect as a Holy book Surah Naas and listen to the recording 194. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate reciting Surah Naas as a prayer Surah Naas for matching using digital devices care of the Qurán
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate reciting Surah Naas as a prayer Surah Naas for matching using digital devices care of the Qurán. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Surah Naas.
2. Explain Surah Naas to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Surah Naas.
4. Show that you can: handle the Qurán with respect as a Holy book Surah Naas and listen to the recording 194
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Surah Naas. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when praying?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. handle the Qurán with respect as a Holy book Surah Naas and listen to the recording 194
2. appreciate reciting Surah Naas as a prayer Surah Naas for matching using digital devices care of the Qurán

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
